description: Start one purchase for several eSIMs and proxy packs together: one payment_url for the whole total, in US dollars outside Nigeria and in naira in Nigeria. This does not charge anyone. After a verified payment every item is delivered within 1 hour. Returns each item reference with its own status_url. Poll get_cart_status with reference and status_token.

accept_terms.description: Set true only if your user agreed to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy on this website.

country.description: Optional: the payer's two-letter country. Outside Nigeria (NG) they pay in US dollars.

currency.description: Optional: USD or NGN. By default prices are in US dollars outside Nigeria and in naira inside Nigeria, from where the request comes from.

email.description: Required: the person's email, for receipts and order details.

email_verification_token.description: verification_token from verify_email_code for this email (required while email checks are on).

items.description: Items: { kind: "esim", location, plan_code, qty } or { kind: "proxy", product, gb, offer_id, target_country, qty }. qty 1 to 5.

name: create_cart_order
